finalists.label: Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy
finalists.why: This candidate has strong for evidence including bilateral weakness of hip flexors, knee flexors, knee extensors, and intrinsic hand muscles, and MRI of the pelvis showed bilateral femoral nerve enlargement without enhancement.

finalists.label: Diabetic Neuropathy
finalists.why: This candidate has strong for evidence including 61-year-old woman with type II diabetes, 1-year history of progressive lower-extremity weakness, and sensation to light touch was reduced in the feet, with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has more specific and decisive for evidence, including bilateral femoral nerve enlargement without enhancement, which is a distinctive feature of this condition.
